title: Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements Milestone Sheet for Domestic Main Cabin Award Prices
content:
**Sheet entry.** The award milestone percentage of a domestic Crestline Main Cabin round-trip award redeemed from Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements company points follows the current agreement year's spend, taken as every spend entry on the agreement less every agreement-year reset entry:

| Current agreement-year spend | Award milestone percentage |
|---|---|
| has reached the tier's spend milestone | 95 percent |
| 80 percent of the spend milestone or more, but below it | 98 percent |
| below 80 percent of the spend milestone | 100 percent (the listed price) |

**How the percentage acts.** The award milestone percentage multiplies the standard domestic award price, the tier's domestic Main Cabin round-trip award points. Where the price carries several such percentages, they are all applied together to the standard price, each divided by one hundred, and the product is rounded to the nearest whole point once.

### Spend levels per tier

| Tier | Spend milestone (USD) | 80 percent of it (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Crestline Business Connect | 50000 | 40000 |
| Crestline Business Connect Plus | 100000 | 80000 |
| Crestline Corporate Select | 250000 | 200000 |
| Crestline Corporate Preferred | 1000000 | 800000 |
| Crestline Corporate Premier | 2500000 | 2000000 |
| Crestline Corporate Strategic | 7500000 | 6000000 |

### Cases (hypothetical)

- Crestline Corporate Select, current-year spend of USD 250000.00: the milestone is reached, 95 percent.
- Crestline Corporate Select, USD 200000.00: 80 percent of the milestone, 98 percent.
- Crestline Corporate Select, USD 199999.99: 100 percent.
- With 95 percent and no other percentage, 1600 points become 1520 points.
